chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn Asbaat, from al-Hakam ibn Miskeen, from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'The one who prays the Salat of Ja'far, Allah, the Mighty and Glorious, will write for him from the reward the like of what the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to Ja'far.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Yes, by Allah.'

key_terms.صَلَاةَ جَعْفَرٍ: Salat of Ja'far (a specific prayer of glorification)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for praying Salat al-Ja'far according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* establishes the spiritual merit of *Salat al-Ja'far* by linking its reward to the unique status granted to Ja'far ibn Abi Talib, known as *Dhu al-Jafl* (the one with much glory), particularly for his role in the Battle of Uhud. The Imam’s affirmation ('I swear by Allah') underscores the authenticity of this specific reward, reflecting the Shia tradition of venerating the Ahl al-Bayt's familial connections to the Prophet's legacy.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Al-Hassan, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Asbaat, from Al-Hakam Bin Miskeen, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘The one who prays a Salāt, the Salāt of Ja’faras, Allahazwj would Write for him, from the Recompense, the like of what Rasool-Allahsaww said to Ja’farasws?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes, by Allahazwj’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn al-Hassan has narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Asbat from al-Hakam ibn Miskin from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following:

“I asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘If one performs Salah (prayer) of Ja‘far, does Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, grant him a reward like that which the Messenger of Allah mentioned for Ja‘far?’ The Imam said, ‘Yes, by Allah, He does so.’”
